title: ED searches seven premises in Hyderabad over alleged ₹326-crore bank fraud
summary: The investigation concerns the alleged defrauding of a consortium of banks led by Punjab National Bank, along with IDBI Bank, Union Bank of India, Andhra Bank (now part of Union Bank of India), and Bank of Baroda, resulting in a loss of ₹326.49 crore

title: Ashoke Sen becomes first Indian physicist to receive Oskar Klein Medal
summary: Mr. Sen is internationally recognised for his pioneering work on S-duality, the precise counting of black hole entropy and string field theory, which have helped shape modern string theory

title: How is Kerala planning to prevent child deaths linked to malnutrition and neglect | Explained
summary: A State-wide vulnerability mapping will be held to identity children living in vulnerable conditions that pose a risk to their health, education, and safety. Once the vulnerable children are identified and their details collected, regular follow-ups will be held

title: Tiger Shroff shooting: Mumbai cops recover two firearms from Surat
summary: According to a police official, crime branch teams tracked the logistical trail of the weapons provided to the assailants, leading them to a hideout in Surat where the firearms were recovered

title: PM Modi, Vladimir Putin direct officials to expand cooperation, target $100 bn trade by 2030: Envoy
summary: Indian envoy Kumar said the two leaders discussed the full range of bilateral relations on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in New Delhi on September 12-13

title: Low pressure over Bay of Bengal likely to turn into cyclonic storm | Live
summary: Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (APSDMA) lists Konaseema, West Godavari, Krishna, Guntur, Bapatla, Prakasam and the Rayalaseema districts for rain

title: Cook from Bihar  dies after being hit by car and dragged for 100 metres in Electronics City
summary: Ranjit suffered serious injuries to his head, chest, right leg and other parts of his body, and succumbed to them.

title: Enhancement of MPs’ development fund key topic selected by Parliamentary panel for study
summary: The committee will examine the guidelines governing the release of MPLADS funds and assess the need to enhance the allocation under the scheme
